record.one_liner: Workspace docs, pages and databases platform with a public REST API and a hosted MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Internal connection API tokens and personal access tokens (static bearer tokens) plus OAuth 2.0 for public connections.
record.access_notes: PATs are created in the Developer portal. On Business and Enterprise plans PAT creation is restricted by default and a workspace owner must enable it, so access there is admin-gated.
record.api_notes: Requests go to api.notion.com/v1 with a Notion-Version header. Breadth judgement from the docs; not verified object by object.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve PAT or internal connection gives API access. Public OAuth distribution needs no Marketplace review to start authorization. Business/Enterprise workspaces may need an admin to enable PAT creation.

evidence.quote: Bearer tokens are provided when you create an internal connection, create a personal access token, or complete the OAuth flow for a public connection.
Create PATs in the Developer portal.
On Business and Enterprise plans, PAT creation is restricted by default.
Connect an MCP client, such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini, through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
You can start authorization as soon as you configure the integration’s client credentials and redirect URI; Marketplace submission or review is not required.
